name: Pengajian AM STPM Objektif
summary: An Android learning application inspired by my experience as an STPM student. It brings together objective quizzes, answer explanations, mistake review and focused ABK practice to support independent revision.
tagline: From personal learning experience to a mobile revision application.
contributions: Define the product requirements and plan the learning flow around students' revision needs.
Use AI tools to support implementation and troubleshooting, then review changes through hands-on checks and test results.
Prioritise fixes and coordinate the release on Google Play, from Closed Testing to production.
coverAlt: Guest home interface showing learning progress, quiz shortcuts and ranking entry
coverCaption: Guest Home — rendered from the application's Flutter widgets.
overview: An Android revision app inspired by my STPM experience, designed to make objective question practice easier to access and repeat.

inspiration.title: Why I Started This Project
paragraphs: During my STPM studies, I found that learning through questions and answers helped me understand facts in the context of an examination. Reviewing incorrect answers also helped me identify what I needed to revisit.
This experience inspired me to explore a mobile application that connects practice, feedback and mistake review in one learning flow.

problem: Pengajian Am STPM involves a lot of facts to remember. As an STPM student, I found that reading factual notes over and over could feel repetitive and boring, making it harder to stay motivated to revise. Finding suitable practice questions also took time and effort.
solution: Pengajian AM STPM Objektif brings objective practice questions into a mobile app so students can practise regularly, wherever they are. Topic-based quizzes, answer explanations and a Mistake Book help them revisit facts, understand their mistakes and focus on areas they have yet to master.

features.title: Topic-based quizzes
features.text: Practise by semester and topic, then review results and available answer explanations.

features.title: Mistake Book
features.text: Return to incorrectly answered questions for another round of revision.

features.title: Focused ABK practice · Semester 2
features.text: Where available, practise Alih Bentuk Komunikasi (ABK) with existing questions selected using rules and available mistake records. Core practice requires no AI request.

features.title: Guest learning
features.text: Start without an account. Progress stays on the current device; completed quiz records can be transferred when signing in.
features.note: Clearing app data or uninstalling can remove guest records that have not been transferred.

architecture: The codebase is organised around application features. Selected modules separate presentation, domain logic and data access to clarify responsibilities and support testing.

challenges.title: Transferring guest progress safely
challenges.problem: Completed guest quiz records must reach the intended account, even when a transfer is interrupted or retried.
challenges.solution: The transfer binds local records to that account and uses import receipts to prevent duplicate attempts. Failed transfers retain the local records for retry.

validation: For release 1.4.2, 562 Flutter tests passed and static analysis reported no issues in lib, test and tools. Selected Home ranking recovery flows were checked on a physical Android device. After Google Play Closed Testing, the app moved to production with version 1.4.4 on 9 November 2026. The current production release is 1.4.11 (18), published on 13 November 2026.

checks: Static analysis reported no issues within lib, test and tools.
The Android release package passed the recorded signing and package checks.
Physical-device checks verified the documented Home ranking recovery scenarios.
The release was available to selected Google Play Closed Testing users.
releaseMilestone.scope: Evidence shown here refers to this release and the documented validation scope.

next: Continue improving content accuracy, continuity of learning and application reliability through feedback and verification.
reflection: This taught me to treat data ownership and failure recovery as part of the learning experience.
